title: Free Night Awards Interpretation Note: Delay Extra on a Replacement's Validity
content:
**Rule.** For a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed, the delay extra counts whole calendar months from the date the hotel relocated the reservation to the date of the award's return from it: at least the upper delay months earn the upper delay extra, at least one month the lower delay extra, and less nothing. The delay extra is added to the replacement validity months before the expiry date is worked out.

| Whole calendar months from relocation to the award's return | Delay extra |
|---|---|
| 3 or more (upper delay months) | 2 months (upper delay extra) |
| 1 or 2 | 1 month (lower delay extra) |
| Less than 1 | No delay extra |

**Where the two dates are read.** The relocation date is the date on the relocated reservation's Room Reservations record on which the hotel relocated it. The date of the award's return is the date of the return record in the replaced award's history that carries the reason that its reservation was relocated.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical relocation on 10 March).**

| Return dated | Whole months | Delay extra |
|---|---|---|
| 9 April | 0 | None |
| 10 April | 1 | 1 month |
| 9 June | 2 | 1 month |
| 10 June | 3 | 2 months |
